work_handoff.title: BLACK_LADY_GENERIC_GUEST_CROWD_CORE_SET_V001｜REAR_3Q Candidate 01
requirements: This Bundle spec does not by itself authorize Work image generation. REAR_3Q Candidate 01 generation requires separate Product Owner authorization.
These are not ten new people. They are the exact same Guest A-J identities already approved in FRONT and LEFT PROFILE, now viewed from a back-dominant REAR_3Q orientation.
FRONT is the primary global identity authority. LEFT PROFILE is secondary side-geometry continuity authority. If they conflict on identity-defining global traits, FRONT WINS.
Target canvas = 1536x1024 landscape / 2 rows x 5 columns.
Fixed slots: top row Guest A/B/C/D/E; bottom row Guest F/G/H/I/J.
Guest A-F are female; Guest G-J are male.
REAR_3Q means back-dominant, approximately 135 degrees from FRONT: continue from LEFT PROFILE toward BACK by about another 45 degrees.
The first-glance read must be REAR 3/4, not front 3/4, not true side profile, and not full BACK.
Bodies remain naturally upright and static. Heads follow body orientation naturally; do not turn heads back toward camera to expose faces.
Preserve identity, apparent age, hairstyle identity, body build, relative height, wardrobe identity, footwear and identity-defining markings from FRONT.
Use LEFT PROFILE only to support side silhouette, side hair volume, garment thickness and side-view body proportions.

Guest I must resolve global identity from FRONT: male, clearly muscular, black sleeveless top, short stiff/brush-cut hairstyle, and identity-defining tattoo/body-marking family where naturally visible.
Do not propagate Guest I's Product Owner-accepted LEFT PROFILE muscular reduction or tattoo-pattern drift as a redesign.
Preserve ten-person identity separation; do not solve REAR_3Q with one repeated rear-side body/head template.
Background must remain simple, neutral and low-distraction. This is a controlled identity reference board, not a Story Shot.
No model-generated letters, names or text labels.
No backpack, shoulder bag, crossbody bag, handbag, luggage, suspicious bag straps, handheld props or story-scene objects.
Generate exactly one REAR_3Q PNG only after separate Product Owner generation authorization, then stop for review.
Do not generate Candidate 02, BACK, N21 or N23 Candidate 02 in this pass.
exclusions: backpacks or bags of any kind
